details.completeness_justification: All key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by sales, order intake, profitability, cash flow, and dividend details. K2 is covered by explicit mention of geopolitical uncertainty, USD/SEK depreciation (~20%), and its impact on 74% of sales. K3 is covered by positive development in ports and mining segments. K4 is covered by cost reductions from discontinuing JLT Software Solutions AB and overhead reductions. K5 is covered by launch of the 15-inch rugged computer and AI safety solution. K6 is covered by inventory reduction and cash position improvement. K7 is covered by the geographical sales shift showing Americas at 70.1% and Nordics at 11.1%. K8 is covered by the defense-market evaluation project costing ~SEK 1 million. No material omissions affect the overall understanding.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. There are no self-contradictions: statements about sales growth, margin declines, cost reductions, and improved losses are mutually consistent. Explanations (e.g., currency movements affecting margins) logically follow from preceding statements. The organization flows logically from overall performance to financial metrics, market conditions, geographic performance, cost measures, cash flow, and new product launches. There is no unnecessary repetition that materially reduces clarity. While segment figures are not reconciled to consolidated totals, the candidate does not claim they should sum, so this does not constitute an internal contradiction.
